summary: Tested new التحضير (Lesson Plans) feature end-to-end. All 9 backend pytest cases pass (catalog counts 11/10/9/10 + 5 variants, GET/PUT/DELETE lesson plans with proper edited=true/false merge, invalid id 404, .docx export is a valid zip with word/document.xml containing lesson title + custom directorate, PUT/GET /api/auth/profile directorate roundtrip). All frontend flows pass on public URL: library-tab-plans navigates correctly from /teacher/library and /teacher/library/videos; 4 grade tabs (5..8) and 5 variant tabs visible; switching grade+lesson (g7-u2-l3) updates sheet content ('تحرير الصور باستخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي' rendered); variant switch updates strategy name; editing objectives + save shows toast + '• معدَّل' badge on variant tab + persists after page reload; directorate input + save persists after reload; export triggers a .docx download with proper Arabic filename; reset removes edit. Cleanup: variant reset applied and directorate restored to default.
critical_code_review_comments: lesson_content.py is a huge single-file data module (~1500+ lines). Consider splitting per-grade for maintainability, but not blocking.
PUT /api/lesson-plans/{id}/{variant} validates lesson id but accepts any Pydantic-typed body; strategies is List[dict] with no shape validation. Low risk since only teacher-owned edits are stored.
seed_data_creation: None. Test data prefixed with in-place edits and cleaned up (reset variant + directorate restored to default).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lesson Plans feature (/teacher/library/plans) is fully working. Backend router in /app/backend/lesson_plans.py, content in /app/backend/lesson_content.py (40 lessons). Auth uses token key 'token' (not 'access_token'). Login page selectors: [data-testid=username-input|password-input|login-btn]. Sheet testid: lesson-plan-sheet; edit textareas: lp-edit-objectives etc.; toolbar: lp-edit-btn/lp-save-btn/lp-reset-btn/lp-export-btn. Grade lesson counts fixed at 11/10/9/10.
